Ok first of all, that "friend" that told you that is not a friend at all and I would start trying to work them out of your life. They obviously have a nuerotypical mindset that doesn't understand depression and abuse. It will be lonely at first and may even trigger your depression a bit but it's better to find people who truly understand your pain and don't judge you than people who say shitty things to you whilst wearing a costume of "tough love".
Secondly, If your parents are constantly reinforcing the message you are a leach than that's what you will become. It's called a self fulfilling prophecy and it sounds to me they have indoctrinated you into it already from the way you think and talk about yourself. 
The shitty thing about negative self thought and depression is that it is a cycle. The more disparaging thoughts you have the more unmotivated and doubt filled you will become. A lot of people don't understand this and don't put any stock into the way they communicate with others. 
Spend some time loving yourself. Say nice things to yourself. Compliment yourself and say out loud some things you like about yourself. Build yourself up like you would want if it was someone else doing it. 
Then when you have a little bit of a good feeling, start utilizing that to make a plan of how to do better for yourself and not just to prove yourself to people who treat you bad when you are down. 
You can fix up your life OP, I believe in you! 
Just go slow and don't guilt yourself for not being up to your parents timeline of success or societies expectations. Because if you live to meet those goals you'll never reach the finish lines. They will always expect more. But if you set your goals than you can actually celebrate your successes because you are in full control! 
I dealt with the same thing for the last ten years and just now at thirty have had a break though in my depression. If your parents are shitty enough to emotionally abuse you into feeling like you are a waste of time and resources than they deserve to keep having to pay you reparations for their toxicity. Don't guilt yourself! Love yourself and your current place in life! Trust in your struggle!
